# mcrl invitation

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage invitations.

```text
Aliases:
  invitation, invitations
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`invitation create`](#mcrl-invitation-create) | Invite someone to the organization |
| [`invitation list`](#mcrl-invitation-list) | List pending invitations |
| [`invitation revoke`](#mcrl-invitation-revoke) | Cancel an invitation |

## mcrl invitation create

Invite someone to the organization.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl invitation create <email> [--authority viewer] [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Invite someone to the organization as a manager, collaborator or viewer.

API: POST /api/v0/invitations
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl invitation create alice@example.com
  mcrl invitation create bob@example.com --authority collaborator

Flags:
      --authority string   manager, collaborator or viewer (default "viewer")
```

## mcrl invitation list

List pending invitations.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl invitation list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List pending invitations.

API: GET /api/v0/invitations
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl invitation list
  mcrl invitation list --jq '.[].email'
```

## mcrl invitation revoke

Cancel an invitation.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl invitation revoke <email>

Cancel an invitation.

API: POST /api/v0/invitations/revoke
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl invitation revoke alice@example.com
  mcrl invitation revoke alice@example.com --yes
```
